remarks: - Please submit your best & final offer by 5pm Monday July 14th, thank you -   Welcome to 41 Arlington Road - a beautifully updated residence nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods. This thoughtfully maintained home combines classic architectural details with modern updates, offering an exceptional living experience just minutes from downtown, parks, and commuter routes. Step inside to sun-filled interiors featuring rich hardwood floors, elegant millwork, and oversized windows that flood the space with natural light. The spacious living room with a gas-burning fireplace invites both relaxation and effortless entertaining. A formal dining room leads to the updated chef's kitchen, complete with sleek stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinetry - ideal for everyday living and hosting alike.  Upstairs, the serene primary suite serves as a private retreat with generous closet space and an updated en-suite bath. Additional bedrooms are bright and well-proportioned, perfect for family, guests, or a home office.  Outdoors, discover a private backyard oasis framed by mature landscaping and flourishing apple, cherry, and apricot trees, offering both beauty and seasonal harvests. The expansive patio and lush lawn provide the perfect backdrop for summer gatherings, gardening, or quiet mornings.
